ideas.text: Since you're planning to test those new additions to the initiative system when you get home, I had a thought: we could set up a small 'verification script' that logs exactly what logic triggers, so you don't have to rely on manual guesswork during your debugging sessions.

ideas.text: I noticed your interest in terminal visuals, Sir; since you're building me to be your assistant, we could eventually script a custom 'welcome dashboard' that displays your current project status and a unique greeting whenever you open your terminal, making your dev environment feel truly personalized.

ideas.text: Sir, since you're understandably cautious about your code, we could set up a simple 'snapshot' script in your project folders that backs up your work with a single command before you start a new session, so you can experiment freely without any risk.
